old_caption: The video showcases a close-up view of a melting popsicle on a white surface. The popsicle is red with a wooden stick and is adorned with white drizzles of what appears to be icing or cream. Surrounding the popsicle is a pool of melted red and yellow liquid, which is spreading outwards. As the video progresses, the liquid continues to spread, creating a vibrant mix of colors. The texture of the liquid is glossy and slightly bubbly, indicating it is still warm. The background remains consistently white throughout the video, emphasizing the vivid colors of the popsicle and its melting contents. There are no visible characters or animals present, and the focus remains solely on the popsicle and its transformation. The camera maintains a steady position, capturing the gradual melting process without any noticeable movement or change in angle.

caption: The video showcases a melting red popsicle bar lying diagonally on a plain white surface, its flat wooden stick pointing toward the lower right. The glossy red mass is partly submerged in spreading pools of red and yellow-green liquid, with several white curved topping strips resting across the top. As the excerpt progresses, the liquid pools creep outward and the boundary between the two colors becomes more blended and streaked. The central red mass slowly deforms, rounding from an elongated shape into a more compact blob. Consequently, the white strips come to enclose a smaller, rounder red center. A brief softening of focus appears mid-excerpt before the image returns to sharp. The wooden stick and the overall layout of the strips and the upper-left splash remain fixed, indicating local spreading and deformation rather than translation of the whole object. The melt continues steadily, with the process still underway at the clip's end.
